findings.evidence: The generic lemmas take `i : Fin t.rank` (`SimplyConnectedRootDatum/Assembly.lean:267`, `:467`; `KostantForm.lean:203`, `:211`). The matching E6 generated files contain no `erw` (grep `erw` in `E6/Minuscule/Generated` finds nothing).
findings.fix: Add E₇ lemmas indexed by `Fin 7` once, next to the existing E₇ root-datum file: `coroot_simpleIndex`, `coroot'_simpleIndex_apply`, `rootGeneratorWeight_inl/inr_eq_root_simpleIndex` and `rootGeneratorWeight_inl/inr`. E6 already does this in `E6/Minuscule/RootDatum.lean:87`. Then replace every `erw` above with `rw`/`simp`.
findings.issue: Six proofs in Coroot.lean and RootWeight.lean need `erw` only because `E7.rank` unfolds to 7. Affected: `generatedTangentMatrixLieHom_corootDifferential` and `generatedCartanVector_eq_corootDifferential` (`erw [coroot'_simpleIndex_apply ..]`, no comment), `generatedCorootCocharacter_eq_namedCoroot` (`erw [.., coroot_simpleIndex]` plus a `change`), and in RootWeight.lean `rootMatrix_apply_eq_zero_of_weight_sub_ne`, `generatedRootVector_mem_adjointWeightSpace` and `weightCharacter_rootGeneratorWeight_mem_nontrivialAdjointWeights`.

findings.evidence: Lines: `erw [E7.rootGeneratorWeight_inl_eq_root_simpleIndex]`, `erw [E7.rootGeneratorWeight_inr_eq_neg_root_simpleIndex, neg_ne_zero]`, `erw [Derivation.mem_nontrivialAdjointWeights]`, `erw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at hz`. The definition at `Tangent/RootSpace.lean:249` is `Iff.rfl`.
findings.fix: Use the E₇ lemmas from the previous finding. Rewrite with `Derivation.mem_nontrivialAdjointWeights` using `rw`, or apply it via `.2`. Derive `hz = 0` with `rw`/`simpa` after stating the weight index at `Fin 7`. If an `erw` must stay, add a comment explaining why.
findings.issue: `weightCharacter_rootGeneratorWeight_mem_nontrivialAdjointWeights` has four `erw` steps with no comment. One rewrites with `Derivation.mem_nontrivialAdjointWeights`, which is `Iff.rfl`; another is `erw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot, ..]`. Nothing says which defeq each step depends on.

findings.evidence: Both proofs end in the identical rewrite chain `generatedCartanVector_eq_corootDifferential, generatedCorootCocharacter, derivationCompLieHom_apply` after `SplitTorus.derivationCompLieHom_tangentBasis` / `SplitTorus.range_derivationCompLieHom`.
findings.fix: Factor out a lemma `derivationCompLieHom_generatedWeightTorusCoordinateMap_tangentBasis : derivationCompLieHom π (SplitTorus.tangentBasis i) = generatedCartanVector R i`, then use it in both proofs (for `heq`, via `funext`, and for the span, via `Set.range_comp`).
findings.issue: The same per-index computation appears twice: once in `range_derivationCompLieHom_generatedWeightTorusCoordinateMap_eq_span` (funext + `rw [generatedCartanVector_eq_corootDifferential, generatedCorootCocharacter, derivationCompLieHom_apply]`) and again in the `heq` step of `linearIndependent_generatedCartanVector`. It identifies the torus image of the coordinate cocharacter differential with `generatedCartanVector`.

summary: Proofs in Coroot.lean and RootWeight.lean repeatedly use `erw` to get the generic `Fin t.rank` root-datum lemmas to apply at `Fin 7`, and several of these uses have no comment. The fix is one set of E₇-specialised lemmas; the coordinate-cocharacter-to-Cartan-vector computation is also written out twice.
